Text:
Your landlord can't raise rent as much as they want 🇹🇷

▪️ The cap: 12-month average CPI. For home leases, the yearly increase can't exceed TÜİK's 12-month average inflation.
▪️ Which month?: Your renewal month. The cap from the month your lease renews applies.
▪️ Find it: TÜİK, around the 3rd. Announced each month with the inflation data. General info, not legal advice.
